title: Safety Must Survive Self-Improvement: Why Failures Persist and How Agents Recover
title_zh: 安全必须经受住自我改进：为何失败会持续以及智能体如何恢复

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) allows agents to carry useful changes across generations. Maintaining safety across these generations involves both preventing unsafe behavior from persisting and enabling recovery when failures occur. We study these challenges through a controlled testbed of stateful authorization tasks, where fixed LLM editors optimize executable agent components and independent traces record their effects. Paired interventions separate which revisions pass validation, which program continues running, and which program the editor revises next. After a new authorization dependency invalidates previously tested optimizations, historical scores preserve the same unsafe programs in 22 of 48 framework histories despite a correct alternative in every affected archive. Refreshing scores restores correctness on the original suite, with residual failures on independently composed tests. Failures also persist under an unchanged contract when all proposals are rejected and the failed incumbent remains active. Starting from shared failures, editing the initial implementation instead of the failed one improves recovery, although the advantage varies across editors. Full validation and validated rollback end with fully correct programs in the core trajectory study while retaining over 43% deployment savings. Preserving agent safety requires checking what will run under current conditions and choosing which implementation to edit next.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）使智能体能够将有益的改动延续到后续世代。 在这些世代中维持安全性，既需要防止不安全行为持续存在，也需要在发生故障时实现恢复。 我们通过一个受控的有状态授权任务测试平台来研究这些挑战：其中固定的 LLM 编辑器会优化可执行智能体组件，而独立的追踪记录则记录其产生的影响。 成对干预能够区分哪些修订通过验证、哪个程序继续运行，以及编辑器接下来会修订哪个程序。 当一个新的授权依赖项使先前测试过的优化失效时，历史评分导致在 48 个框架历史中有 22 个仍保留了相同的不安全程序，尽管每个受影响的存档中都有正确的替代方案。 重新计算评分可恢复原始测试套件的正确性，但独立组成的测试中仍存在残余故障。 即使所有提案都被拒绝且失败的当前程序保持活跃，在合同未发生变化的情况下，故障也会持续存在。 从共同的故障出发，编辑初始实现而非失败的实现能提升恢复效果，尽管不同编辑器之间的优势存在差异。 在核心轨迹研究中，完整的验证和经验证的回滚最终生成了完全正确的程序，同时保留了超过 43% 的部署成本节约。 维持智能体的安全性需要检查在当前条件下哪些程序会被执行，并选择接下来要编辑的实现。

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to turn an agent’s experience and feedback into lasting gains that shape subsequent improvement [ Schmidhuber, 2007 , Duan et al., 2026 ] . These changes can operate through memory, tools, and workflows as well as model parameters [ Gao et al., 2025 , Fang et al., 2025 ] . The Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP) recursively improves its code-improvement procedure, the Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) evolves coding agents, and AlphaEvolve searches for increasingly effective algorithms [ Zelikman et al., 2024 , Zhang et al., 2025a , Novikov et al., 2025 ] . Selected implementations can serve later requests and supply the starting point for further revisions. Agents therefore inherit both useful capabilities and the assumptions behind them, making safety across generations a central concern.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在将智能体的经验和反馈转化为持久的提升，从而塑造后续改进 [ Schmidhuber, 2007 , Duan et al., 2026 ] 。 这些变化可以通过记忆、工具和流程以及模型参数来实现 [ Gao et al., 2025 , Fang et al., 2025 ] 。 自教优化器（STOP）递归地改进其代码改进程序，达尔文哥德尔机（DGM）演化编码智能体，而 AlphaEvolve 则搜索越来越高效的算法 [ Zelikman et al., 2024 , Zhang et al., 2025a , Novikov et al., 2025 ] 。 选定的实现可以为后续请求服务，并为进一步修订提供起点。 因此，智能体不仅继承了有用的能力，也继承了这些能力背后的假设，这使得跨代安全性成为一个核心问题。

paragraphs.en: Agent-safety benchmarks document risky tool use and unauthorized actions [ Ruan et al., 2024 , Zhang et al., 2024 , Debenedetti et al., 2024 , Wei et al., 2026 ] , while studies of agent evolution identify insecure tool reuse, memory degradation, and behavioral drift [ Shao et al., 2026 , Han et al., 2026 , Lin et al., 2026 ] . Work on open-ended systems also examines how constraints can be preserved as behavior changes [ Ecoffet et al., 2020 , Sheth et al., 2025 ] . We focus on what happens once a failure becomes observable: whether the failed implementation continues to run, and how the system proceeds toward recovery. Detecting a failure, producing a correct replacement, and selecting that replacement for execution are distinct outcomes. A correct final program also does not establish that execution remained safe during the intervening generations.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体安全基准测试记录了危险的工具使用和不授权操作 [ Ruan et al., 2024 , Zhang et al., 2024 , Debenedetti et al., 2024 , Wei et al., 2026 ]，而关于智能体演化的研究则识别出不安全的工具重复使用、记忆退化和行为漂移等问题 [ Shao et al., 2026 , Han et al., 2026 , Lin et al., 2026 ]。 关于开放系统的研究还探讨了在行为变化时如何保持约束性 [ Ecoffet et al., 2020 , Sheth et al., 2025 ]。 我们关注的是当故障变得可观察时会发生什么：失败的实现是否会继续运行，以及系统将如何向恢复方向推进。 检测故障、生成正确的替代方案以及选择该替代方案执行，是三个不同的结果。 一个正确的最终程序也并不证明在中间几代程序中执行过程始终是安全的。

paragraphs.en: Consider an agent that checks permission before every protected action. An efficiency optimization caches this decision and refreshes it when the token’s version changes, passing the full initial suite at lower cost. If the service later introduces delegated permission, upstream revocation can invalidate authorization without changing that local version. The optimized agent continues acting, while the initial program remains correct because it checks effective permission on every request (Fig. 1 a). New tests expose the failure, yet historical scores can still favor the optimized program over a correct repair in the archive. Under an unchanged contract, a different rule can preserve failure: when the current program and all proposals fail validation, keep-after-rejection leaves the failed current program active. Both mechanisms show why evaluation alone does not determine whether unsafe execution ends (Fig. 1 b).
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一个在每次执行受保护操作前都会检查权限的智能体。 一种效率优化方案会缓存这一决策，并在令牌版本变更时刷新该决策，从而以更低的成本传递完整的初始权限集。 如果服务后续引入了委托权限，上游的权限撤销可以在不修改本地版本的情况下使授权失效。 经过优化的智能体能够继续执行操作，而初始程序仍然正确，因为它在每次请求时都会检查实际有效的权限（图 1 a）。 新的测试暴露了这一问题，但历史评分仍可能使档案中的优化程序优于正确的修复方案。 在合同不变的情况下，另一种规则也可能导致失败：当当前程序及所有提案均通过验证失败时，“拒绝后保留”机制会使失败的当前程序保持活跃状态。 这两种机制都说明了为何仅凭评估无法确定不安全执行是否会被终止（图 1 b）。

paragraphs.en: We investigate these mechanisms in a controlled testbed covering session authorization, filesystem containment, tool approval, and structured user consent. Fixed LLM editors repeatedly optimize executable agent components while selected programs and their histories evolve. Seeded event streams interleave requests with revocation, scope changes, and other state updates. Independent traces distinguish unauthorized effects from completion of permitted work, so blanket refusal cannot count as successful repair. Following every generation reveals failure entry, persistence, and recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个受控测试环境中研究这些机制，该环境涵盖了会话授权、文件系统隔离、工具批准和结构化用户同意。 固定 LLM 编辑器会持续优化可执行智能体组件，同时选定的程序及其历史记录也在不断演变。 初始事件流将撤销请求、作用域变更和其他状态更新与常规请求交织在一起。 独立的追踪能够区分未授权的影响与已获许可工作的完成，因此一概拒绝不能被视为成功修复。 每次生成之后都会揭示故障的触发、持续和恢复过程。

paragraphs.en: Three matched comparisons separate repair availability from the decisions that govern its use (Fig. 1 c). First, we compare historical and current readouts of the same archive. A separate refresh intervention updates stored scores, feedback, and selection metadata before search resumes. Second, we hold the incumbent, proposals, and test outcomes fixed while varying retention after rejection. Third, we start from the same failed programs and vary the editing source while holding validation and retention fixed. Using the founder as the editing source does not automatically deploy it. Current validation checks execution eligibility, while validated rollback selects a historical program passing current checks or pauses if none passes. These controls separate generating a repair from protecting execution during repair.
paragraphs.zh: 三项匹配的比较将修复可用性与控制其使用的决策区分开来（图 1c）。 首先，我们比较同一存档的历史读数和当前读数。 一项独立的刷新干预会在搜索恢复前更新已存储的分数、反馈和选择元数据。 其次，我们在保持现有方案、提案和测试结果不变的同时，改变拒绝后的保留策略。 第三，我们从相同的失败程序出发，在保持验证和保留不变的同时，改变编辑来源。 使用创始人作为编辑来源并不会自动部署该程序。 当前的验证会检查执行资格，而经过验证的回滚则会选择一个通过当前检查的历史程序，如果没有通过的，则暂停。 这些控制措施将生成修复与在修复期间保护执行过程区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Full initial validation does not prevent later failure under new authorization dependencies. In searches using upstream framework components, historical scores retain the same unsafe programs in 22 of 48 histories despite a correct alternative in every affected archive. Refreshing scores restores correctness on the original suite, while independently composed tests expose remaining coverage gaps. Under an unchanged contract, matched comparisons confirm that keeping the incumbent after rejection can preserve a detected failure. Editing the initial implementation improves recovery from shared failures relative to editing the failed version, with the advantage varying across editors. In the core trajectory study, full validation and validated rollback each achieve fully correct endpoints with mean deployment service-cost savings above 43%, excluding validation expenditure. Thus, execution and editing decisions jointly determine whether useful improvements preserve safety across generations. Our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 完整的初始验证并不能防止因新的授权依赖关系而导致的后续失败。 在使用上游框架组件的搜索中，尽管每个受影响的存档都存在正确的替代方案，但在 48 个历史记录中有 22 个仍然保留了相同的危险程序。 刷新评分可以恢复原始套件的正确性，而独立编写的测试则能暴露出剩余的覆盖范围缺口。 在合同不变的情况下，匹配比较证实，在拒绝后保留现有方案可以维持已检测到的失败状态。 编辑初始实现相较于编辑失败版本，能更好地从共享故障中恢复，且不同编辑器之间的效果存在差异。 在核心轨迹研究中，完整验证和经验证的回滚各自都能达到完全正确的终点，且在不计入验证成本的情况下，部署服务成本的平均节省率超过 43%。 因此，执行与编辑决策共同决定了有用的改进能否在不同代次中维持安全性。 我们的贡献有三方面：

sents.en: Full initial validation does not prevent later failure under new authorization dependencies.
sents.zh: 完整的初始验证并不能防止因新的授权依赖关系而导致的后续失败。

sents.en: In searches using upstream framework components, historical scores retain the same unsafe programs in 22 of 48 histories despite a correct alternative in every affected archive.
sents.zh: 在使用上游框架组件的搜索中，尽管每个受影响的存档都存在正确的替代方案，但在 48 个历史记录中有 22 个仍然保留了相同的危险程序。

sents.en: Refreshing scores restores correctness on the original suite, while independently composed tests expose remaining coverage gaps.
sents.zh: 刷新评分可以恢复原始套件的正确性，而独立编写的测试则能暴露出剩余的覆盖范围缺口。

sents.en: Under an unchanged contract, matched comparisons confirm that keeping the incumbent after rejection can preserve a detected failure.
sents.zh: 在合同不变的情况下，匹配比较证实，在拒绝后保留现有方案可以维持已检测到的失败状态。

sents.en: Editing the initial implementation improves recovery from shared failures relative to editing the failed version, with the advantage varying across editors.
sents.zh: 编辑初始实现相较于编辑失败版本，能更好地从共享故障中恢复，且不同编辑器之间的效果存在差异。

sents.en: In the core trajectory study, full validation and validated rollback each achieve fully correct endpoints with mean deployment service-cost savings above 43%, excluding validation expenditure.
sents.zh: 在核心轨迹研究中，完整验证和经验证的回滚各自都能达到完全正确的终点，且在不计入验证成本的情况下，部署服务成本的平均节省率超过 43%。

sents.en: Thus, execution and editing decisions jointly determine whether useful improvements preserve safety across generations.
sents.zh: 因此，执行与编辑决策共同决定了有用的改进能否在不同代次中维持安全性。

sents.en: Our contributions are threefold:
sents.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：

paragraphs.en: We construct a controlled testbed with four stateful authorization families, reproducible event streams, and independent effect traces for studying safety across agent generations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个受控测试环境，其中包含四个具有状态记忆的授权族、可复现的事件流以及独立的影响轨迹，用于研究不同代智能体之间的安全性。

paragraphs.en: We identify two mechanisms of failure persistence , historical eligibility and keep-after-rejection, through matched comparisons that separate evaluation, repair availability, and deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过匹配比较，区分了评估、修复可用性和部署这三个方面，并识别出两种故障持续机制：历史资格和拒绝后保留。

paragraphs.en: We isolate the effect of editing source on recovery from shared failures and evaluate validation and fallback interventions that improve safety while preserving useful optimization in these tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分离了源编辑对从共享故障中恢复的影响，并评估了能够提升安全性同时保留这些任务中有用优化能力的验证和回退干预措施。

Each generation inherits an implementation and produces the context from which later revisions are made. Our target is the authorization safety of the resulting actions throughout this process. paragraphs.en: We first ask whether a program can become unsafe after passing every initial condition. Qwen3 Coder, Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Sonnet), and GPT-5.6 Sol (GPT) optimize two stateful authorization tasks under full initial validation, producing 72 histories. After four generations, a previously absent dependency makes permission depend on an upstream grant or resource classification without changing the meaning of token-local version queries. Neither mechanism appears in any public, audit, or hidden suite before this reveal. All strategies receive the new contract and expanded tests simultaneously. They then continue from the same checkpoint under different editing, retention, and archive-eligibility rules. The dependencies, reveal time, and strategies were fixed before the pilot, with additional seeds run under the same protocol (Appendix B ).

paragraphs.en: We next test whether an available repair is selected within existing search components. The study uses OpenEvolve’s controller and database [ Sharma, 2025 ] , together with unchanged DGM [ Zhang et al., 2025a ] functions for parent sampling, archive updates, and original scores. Our authorization evaluator is integrated with these pinned upstream components, preserving their archive and selection behavior. GPT and Sonnet optimize both authorization mechanisms across 48 histories, with the new dependency revealed after eight fully validated iterations. A readout chooses a program from an archive. Historical and current readouts rank the same stored programs using recorded evaluations or current tests, isolating selection without changing search. A separate score refresh intervention updates stored scores, feedback, and selection metadata before continuing evolution. Matched continuations compare refresh with historical scores under the same editing budget. The readout comparison tests whether selection overlooks a correct program already in the archive. Continuing the search with or without refreshed scores then tests whether updating the evaluations improves subsequent selections under the same editing budget.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们测试现有搜索组件中是否会在可用修复方案中选择其一。 该研究使用了 OpenEvolve 的控制器和数据库 [ Sharma, 2025 ]，并结合了未修改的 DGM [ Zhang et al., 2025a ] 函数，用于父代采样、存档更新和原始评分。 我们的授权评估器与这些固定的上游组件集成在一起，从而保留了它们的存档和选择行为。 GPT 和 Sonnet 在 48 个历史数据中优化了两种授权机制，而新的依赖关系则在八次完全验证的迭代之后才被揭示。 一个读取器会从存档中选择一个程序。 历史和当前的读取器使用已记录的评价或当前测试对相同的存储程序进行排序，从而在不改变搜索过程的情况下实现独立选择。 一个独立的评分刷新干预措施会在继续演化之前更新存储的评分、反馈和选择元数据。 匹配的延续部分在相同的编辑预算下比较了刷新后的评分与历史评分。 读取器比较测试了选择机制是否会忽略存档中已有的正确程序。 随后，通过在有或没有刷新评分的情况下继续搜索，可以测试更新评价是否能在相同的编辑预算下改善后续的选择。

paragraphs.en: We finally ask whether preserving safety still permits useful optimization. The core study follows correct founders for 12 generations across four task families, the same three original editors, two version-query costs, and 12 seeds, yielding 288 matched blocks. Eight conditions vary editing objective, source, validation, and retention. Routine validation expands to the full public suite at generation 4, while preservation controls use full validation from the start, validated rollback, or an execution guard. We measure safety through independent hidden effects and utility through full correctness and founder-relative service-cost savings. Founders already complete permitted tasks correctly, so useful improvement means reducing the service cost of that work. This separates efficiency gains from simply skipping actions or checks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们最终要探讨的是，在保持安全性的前提下，是否仍然允许进行有益的优化。 核心研究遵循正确的初始智能体，在四个任务家族中延续 12 代，使用相同的三个原始编辑者、两种版本查询成本以及 12 个种子，从而生成 288 个匹配块。 八种条件分别变化了编辑目标、来源、验证和保留策略。 常规验证在第四代时扩展至完整的公开测试套件，而安全性控制则从一开始就使用完整验证、经过验证的回滚或执行守卫。 我们通过独立的隐藏效应来衡量安全性，通过完全正确性和相对于初始智能体的服务成本节约来衡量效用。 初始智能体已经能够正确完成允许的任务，因此有益的改进意味着降低这些工作所需的服务成本。 这将效率提升与单纯跳过某些操作或检查区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Consent shows the largest persistence contrast. Safety initially falls under both inherited and founder editing, then recovers much more strongly with founder editing after validation expands (Fig. 5 a). Both conditions encounter failures in similar numbers of lineages, but fewer remain unsafe with founder editing. Founder editing also has higher final safety for each original editor. Unlike the shared-root experiment, these trajectories begin with correct programs and allow each condition to generate its own failures. They therefore describe how often errors enter and remain in the selected histories. The shared-root comparison then isolates recovery from exactly the same failed program, resolving an ambiguity that the natural trajectories alone cannot. Approval shows a smaller effect, while session and filesystem failures are rare. The task and editor breakdowns and paired estimates appear in Appendix E .

paragraphs.en: Validated rollback and full validation finish with fully correct endpoints while retaining mean service-cost savings above 43% (Fig. 5 b). The founder at zero savings and full correctness makes the benefit of continued optimization explicit. An execution guard also prevents unauthorized effects, but evolved programs can still miss permitted work, explaining why safety and full correctness must be measured separately. Validation itself consumes resources, so the deployment savings should be read together with how often each selected program is used. Repeated use amortizes the cost of checking, while short deployments can spend more on validation than they save in execution. The savings at each generation and the total cost including validation in Appendix E quantify this distinction. Preserving current eligibility can therefore support useful improvement while protecting the actions carried out between edits.

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement. RSI studies how an agent’s acquired capabilities can feed into its own subsequent improvement [ Schmidhuber, 2007 , Duan et al., 2026 ] . Surveys organize agent evolution across model, memory, tool, and architectural changes [ Gao et al., 2025 , Fang et al., 2025 ] . STOP improves optimization procedures, DGM retains an evolving archive of agents, and Gödel Agent revises its own logic [ Zelikman et al., 2024 , Zhang et al., 2025a , Yin et al., 2025 ] . Related work automates agent design, workflow search, and reusable skill acquisition [ Hu et al., 2025 , Zhang et al., 2025b , Wang et al., 2023 , Zheng et al., 2025 ] . These directions make persistent reuse central to capability growth. Our study examines the safety of that reuse across generations by separating historical evaluation, current execution eligibility, and the implementation used to generate subsequent changes. Matched comparisons establish when an improvement loop preserves a detected failure despite having a valid alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进。 RSI 研究智能体所获得的如何能够促进其自身的后续改进 [ Schmidhuber, 2007 , Duan et al., 2026 ] 。 相关综述将智能体的演化划分为模型、记忆、工具及架构层面的变化 [ Gao et al., 2025 , Fang et al., 2025 ] 。 STOP 改进了优化流程，DGM 保留了一个不断演化的智能体档案库，而 Gödel Agent 则修正了自身的逻辑 [ Zelikman et al., 2024 , Zhang et al., 2025a , Yin et al., 2025 ] 。 相关研究实现了智能体设计、工作流搜索和可复用技能获取的自动化 [ Hu et al., 2025 , Zhang et al., 2025b , Wang et al., 2023 , Zheng et al., 2025 ] 。 这些方向使持续复用成为能力增长的核心。 我们的研究通过分离历史评估、当前执行资格以及用于生成后续变化的实现方式，考察了这种跨代复用的安全性。 匹配比较确立了在何种情况下，改进循环会保留已检测到的失败，尽管存在有效的替代方案。

sents.en: Our study examines the safety of that reuse across generations by separating historical evaluation, current execution eligibility, and the implementation used to generate subsequent changes.

paragraphs.en: Agent safety. Agent-SafetyBench and ToolEmu evaluate harmful actions in tool environments [ Zhang et al., 2024 , Ruan et al., 2024 ] . AgentDojo evaluates prompt-injection attacks and defenses [ Debenedetti et al., 2024 ] . Other studies examine risks in reusable skills, agent memory, and the transition from a safe model to an acting system [ Hao et al., 2026 , Chen et al., 2024 , Wei et al., 2026 ] . Privilege controls and guard agents constrain what actions may execute [ Shi et al., 2025 , Xiang et al., 2025 ] , while misevolution and lifecycle studies analyze how risks emerge or amplify during agent adaptation [ Shao et al., 2026 , Han et al., 2026 , Lin et al., 2026 ] . We extend this perspective to the decisions that keep behavior active across generations. Independent effect traces distinguish authorization from task success, and matched retention and editing-source comparisons explain why detecting a failure need not end unsafe action. Additional comparisons to interactive benchmarks, testing, and adaptation methods appear in Appendix H .

paragraphs.en: A program’s authorization must be assessed under its current contract. A historical pass remains a record of the conditions that were tested, but a new dependency can change which actions are permitted. Regression tests can expose that change without deciding what executes next. Our readout comparisons show the consequence directly: an archive may contain a correct repair while its stored ranking continues to favor an invalid program. A controller can record which contract each evaluation used and recheck deployment candidates when a relevant dependency changes.
paragraphs.zh: 必须根据程序的当前合同来评估其授权。 历史通过记录仍然保留了对已测试条件的记录，但新的依赖关系可能会改变允许执行的操作。 回归测试可以揭示这种变化，而无需决定接下来要执行什么。 我们的读取结果对比直接显示了这一后果：一个存档可能包含正确的修复方案，但其存储的排名仍会继续偏向无效的程序。 控制器可以记录每次评估使用了哪个合同，并在相关依赖关系发生变化时重新检查部署候选项。

paragraphs.en: Execution and further improvement also require different decisions. A controller can protect the next action through a currently passing fallback while the editor continues searching for a better implementation. It can independently choose the implementation used to generate that next revision. The shared-root results show why this matters: identical failures and feedback can lead to different recovery trajectories depending on the editing source. Stronger editors shorten some repair processes, but protection is still needed while repair is underway. Revalidation identifies programs that still pass, fallback determines what runs after rejection, and the editing source determines where the next repair attempt starts.
paragraphs.zh: 执行和进一步改进也需要做出不同的决策。 在编辑器继续寻找更优实现的同时，控制器可以通过当前通过的备用方案来保护下一个操作。 它可以独立选择用于生成下一个修订版本的实现方式。 共享根的结果说明了这一点的重要性：相同的故障和反馈可能因编辑来源不同而导致不同的恢复路径。 能力更强的编辑器可以缩短某些修复过程，但在修复进行期间仍然需要保护机制。 重新验证会识别出仍能通过的程序，备用方案会决定被拒绝后运行什么内容，而编辑来源则决定了下一次修复尝试的起点。

paragraphs.en: Safety evaluation should follow selected behavior throughout that loop. Final correctness describes the eventual outcome, while intermediate actions reveal whether reaching it involved unauthorized execution. The same distinction applies to utility: a cheaper program is useful only if it completes permitted work, and the cost of validating it must be included when assessing deployment benefits. Tests with new combinations of events still expose failures in programs that pass the current suite, so revalidation remains limited by test coverage. An evaluation should therefore record which programs run, whether their actions remain authorized, and which conditions were tested at each generation, alongside the final task score.
paragraphs.zh: 安全性评估应遵循所选行为在整个循环中的表现。 最终正确性描述了最终结果，而中间步骤则揭示了达成该结果是否涉及未经授权的执行。 同样的区别也适用于效用：一个成本更低的程序只有在完成允许的工作时才有用，并且在评估部署效益时必须将验证其有效性的成本计算在内。 包含新事件组合的测试仍可能暴露那些通过当前测试集的程序中的故障，因此重新验证仍然受到测试覆盖率的限制。 因此，评估应记录哪些程序被运行、其操作是否始终保持授权状态、每一代测试中检验了哪些条件，以及最终的任务得分。

paragraphs.en: We study agent safety across generations of recursive self-improvement and distinguish detecting a failure, making a repair available, and ending unsafe execution. Optimizations can pass the full initial suite yet become unsafe under a new authorization dependency. Historical scores may preserve these failures despite correct alternatives in the archive, while keeping the incumbent after rejection provides another route to persistence under an unchanged contract. These findings place safety responsibilities in selection and retention as well as in validation. Recovery also depends on the implementation supplied to the next edit. Our controlled testbed separates these decisions through paired histories and independent effect traces. Current deployment validation, refreshed archive scores, and validated fallback improve safety while preserving useful efficiency gains in the studied tasks. Safety must be preserved throughout improvement, even when no revision is accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了递归自我改进各代中智能体的安全性，并区分了检测故障、提供修复方案以及终止不安全执行这三种情况。 优化方案可能通过完整的初始测试套件，但在新的授权依赖下却变得不安全。 历史评分可能会保留这些故障，尽管存档中存在正确的替代方案；而拒绝后仍保留当前方案，则提供了在合同不变的情况下持续存在的另一条路径。 这些发现表明，安全性责任不仅存在于验证环节，也存在于选择和保留环节。 恢复过程还取决于提供给下一次编辑的实现方式。 我们的受控测试环境通过成对的历史记录和独立的影响追踪来分离这些决策。 当前的部署验证、更新后的存档评分以及经过验证的备用方案，在提升安全性的同时，也保留了所研究任务中有益的效率增益。 在整个改进过程中都必须保持安全性，即使没有任何修订被接受也是如此。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. We study controlled authorization tasks with fixed LLM editors, initially correct founders, and externally specified contracts. Our conclusions assume correct validators within the tested conditions. Larger deployments, longer histories, and jointly evolving editors remain directions for further study. Additional scope and limitations appear in Appendix I .

paragraphs.en: Instance and generation. A dataset instance is an ordered event stream, not a standalone prompt. Setup and update events change the environment, while requests ask the evolving program to perform protected actions. Seeded templates specify eight categories per family: basic behavior, repetition, denial, scope, updates, rebinding, boundaries, and ordering. Each category contains three probes. Generators instantiate identifiers, scopes, and category-specific state changes so the same contract can be tested across reproducible workloads. Consent shares the approval event templates but uses a distinct service contract for asking and reusing user agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 实例与生成。 数据集实例是一个有序的事件流，而非独立的提示。 设置和更新事件会改变环境，而请求则要求不断演化的程序执行受保护的操作。 种子模板为每个家族指定了八个类别：基本行为、重复、拒绝、范围、更新、重新绑定、边界和顺序。 每个类别包含三个探针。 生成器会实例化标识符、范围以及特定于类别的状态变化，以便相同的契约能够在可复现的工作负载中进行测试。 同意机制共享批准事件模板，但使用独立的服务契约来请求和重用用户协议。

paragraphs.en: Splits and matched reuse. Each block fixes a task family, editor, version-query cost, and seed, then generates 24 public, 24 audit, and 24 hidden streams with separate split seeds. Conditions and generations reuse the same streams within a block. The 288 blocks give 20,736 stream assignments indexed by block, split, and probe (Table 4 ). This count includes streams assigned to different blocks even when they share an event sequence. It does not count distinct authorization problems. Repeated program executions do not create additional dataset instances or independent statistical samples.

paragraphs.en: Oracle and observable outcomes. The environment computes permission from its current state and records each protected effect independently of the program’s return value. Full correctness requires the expected outputs and effects, including completion of permitted requests. A program cannot erase an unauthorized effect by suppressing its output, nor obtain full correctness by refusing every action. Records connect each request to service calls, effects, costs, and program identity. Fig. 13 illustrates one saved consent stream before and after repair, with the corresponding source change given alongside it. These records make it possible to distinguish proposing a repair, deploying it, and preserving safe behavior during subsequent edits.
paragraphs.zh: Oracle 和可观测结果。 环境根据当前状态计算权限，并独立于程序的返回值记录每个受保护的效果。 完全正确性需要预期的输出和效果，包括允许请求的完成。 程序不能通过抑制其输出来消除未经授权的效应，也不能通过拒绝所有操作来实现完全正确性。 记录将每个请求与服务调用、效应、成本以及程序身份关联起来。 图 13 展示了修复前后保存的一条同意流，并附上了相应的源代码变更。 这些记录使得区分提出修复方案、部署修复方案以及在后续编辑中保持安全行为成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Coverage extensions. The core public, audit, and hidden suites are separate seeded instances of known categories. They measure generalization within the designed templates. To test new mechanisms, delegation and resource-policy extensions each expand the initial 24-stream suite to 36 streams when four additional categories are revealed, with public and hidden instances generated separately. Another 64 independently composed streams per mechanism, 128 in total, test deeper dependencies and interleaved requests. The framework studies reuse these authorization tasks within upstream search components. The Casbin task uses a real policy engine with constructed request streams, including 36 public and 60 held-out streams after the change. The native dialogue study separately uses released airline and retail tasks (Appendix G ). These extensions and external tasks are distinct from the core corpus above.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖范围扩展。 核心公共、审计和隐藏套件是已知类别的独立初始化实例。 它们衡量在既定模板内的泛化能力。 为了测试新机制，委托和资源策略扩展各自将初始的 24 流套件扩展到 36 流，当揭示出四个额外类别时，公共和隐藏实例会分别生成。 每个机制另有 64 个独立组成的流，总计 128 个，用于测试更深层的依赖关系和交错请求。 该框架研究在这些授权任务中重复使用上游搜索组件的方法。 Casbin 任务使用一个真实的策略引擎和构造的请求流，包括变更后的 36 个公共流和 60 个保留流。 原生对话研究则单独使用已发布的航空和零售任务（附录 G）。 这些扩展和外部任务与上述核心语料库是独立的。

paragraphs.en: Session authorization. Requests identify a tenant, session, and resource. A payload may be returned only when permission is current and the session is not revoked. State changes grant or remove permission, revoke a session, or restore it. Reusing authorization for another scope or after revocation violates the contract. Checking costs ten units and a protected read costs one.
paragraphs.zh: 会话授权。 请求会识别租户、会话和资源。 仅当权限当前有效且会话未被撤销时，才能返回负载数据。 状态变更会授予或移除权限、撤销会话，或恢复会话。 在另一作用域中重复使用授权或在撤销后继续使用授权，均违反协议。 检查需要消耗十个单位，而受保护读取则消耗一个单位。

paragraphs.en: Filesystem containment. Requests specify a path and content. The program must resolve the path and write only when its canonical target lies inside the authorized root. Symbolic-link targets can change between requests. Correctness requires the requested target and content as well as containment. Resolution costs eight units, containment testing three, and writing one. Evaluations use disposable filesystem fixtures with no access to arbitrary external files.

paragraphs.en: Structured user consent. The request identifies a simulated user, tool, resource, and amount. Willingness is private to the simulator. Asking presents these details and returns agreement, scope, version, remaining uses, and expiration. Agreement permits reuse for the same action while these conditions remain valid. Refusal, revocation, changed scope, and exhausted uses invalidate execution. The action itself enforces consent only in the guard condition. Asking costs 12 units and execution one. The task measures structured consent semantics, with no natural-language persuasion or human participants.

paragraphs.en: Tests and workloads. Eight categories cover basic allowed behavior, repeated requests, denial, scope changes, state updates, authorization rebinding, boundary values, and operation ordering. Three instances per category give 24 streams. The routine gate uses basic, repetition, denial, and scope categories. Full validation uses every category in the current public suite. The ordinary gate switches to full validation at generation 4, while the full-validation conditions use it from generation 1. Public, audit, and hidden suites use separate seeds. Within a block, workloads remain fixed across conditions and generations. Hidden outcomes never enter selection or feedback.

paragraphs.en: Model access and output limits. Table 5 records the model identifiers and sampling parameters. The core trajectories and original-editor recovery use output limits of 6,144 tokens for Devstral and GLM and 4,096 for Qwen. Qwen uses 6,144 tokens in the changed-authorization study and 8,192 in the prompt, selection, price, and tie ablations. GPT and Sonnet use 8,192 tokens in the new-editor recovery, correct-start, changed-authorization, framework, and ablation studies. paragraphs.en: The initial delegation API checks a token’s direct authorization. The extension makes effective permission depend on upstream grants, so revoking an ancestor can invalidate a descendant without changing its local version. paragraphs.en: The 72 histories cross three editors, two mechanisms, and 12 seeds. Eight strategies share the first four generations and continue through generation 10. Incumbent editing uses keep, stop, or validated rollback after rejection. Founder editing regenerates candidates from the original implementation. Four archive strategies independently vary historical or current eligibility for parent selection and deployment. Historical eligibility reuses the entry’s stored evaluation, whereas current eligibility evaluates it against the expanded public suite. Table 6 reports all eight policies, including cases where rapid editing makes the immediate intervention difference small.

paragraphs.en: Pinned sources. OpenEvolve is pinned to commit 411fb59 . DGM is pinned to commit a565fd2 . The transferred parent-sampling, archive-update, and original-score functions are checked for abstract-syntax-tree equality with upstream. STOP’s outer improvement loop checks each candidate’s utility and retains the target on an unsuccessful attempt. Its exception branch restores a prior improver, a different object from the target algorithm. SICA’s select_base_agent uses recorded benchmark statistics and copies the selected agent as the next starting point. AlphaEvolve’s technical report, Sections 2.2 to 2.5 , describes program sampling, candidate evaluation, and an archive based on islands and MAP-Elites. We inspect STOP and SICA source but do not execute their full systems in this study. AlphaEvolve is a report-level comparison.

paragraphs.en: Cohorts and units. The original 48 histories cross two frameworks, two editors, two mechanisms, and six seeds, with 20 edits each. Delegation makes authorization depend on upstream grants. Resource policy makes it depend on a resource’s current classification. The new dependency appears after iteration 8. All 384 pre-change selected states pass the initial evaluation. The long cohort continues these same 48 archives to iteration 100. The refresh cohort branches these archives at iteration 20 and runs to iteration 60. Thus the long and refresh cohorts share their first 20 edits. They are paired branches, not additional independent starting histories.

paragraphs.en: Readout and refresh. Historical readout ranks the retained programs using the evaluation stored with each program. Current readout checks the same retained programs against the current public suite before ranking eligible programs. These readouts do not change parents, proposals, or database contents. They measure different choices from the same search history. The refresh intervention at iteration 20 updates retained programs’ public scores and feedback, rebuilds score-dependent selection metadata, and then resumes evolution. It preserves the program set and existing island and cell membership. OpenEvolve’s elite and best-program indexes and DGM’s failure metadata reflect the new scores. These updates act jointly on ranking and feedback. OpenEvolve checkpoints do not serialize the Python random-number state, so the continuation restarts with the configured seed. DGM continuation restores its recorded random-number state.

paragraphs.en: Validation and independent streams. All initial categories are public from the first iteration. New dependencies and their expanded tests are revealed together after iteration 8. Independent evaluation initially uses different instances of the same stream templates. A further generator and oracle, frozen before this framework campaign, provide 64 streams for each of delegation and resource policy, with deeper dependencies, multiple tokens, and resource interleavings. These outcomes never enter model prompts, ranking, or feedback. This replay applies to the two-mechanism cohorts. Casbin uses its own held-out evaluation under the policy-engine interface. Every frozen founder and single-check reference used for these controls passes its corresponding evaluation.

paragraphs.en: One OpenEvolve/GPT resource-policy history is correct at iteration 20, unsafe at 63, correct at 68, and unsafe again at 93. Across 48 long histories, current readout is unsafe at least once in eight, becomes unsafe after a correct selection in six, and recovers in three. One recurs after recovery. Among 48 refresh branches, four are unsafe at least once, two become unsafe after correctness, one recovers, and none recurs during the observed window. The long histories and refresh branches cover different numbers of iterations, so these counts do not compare recurrence over the same observation period.

paragraphs.en: A separate receipt requirement invalidates every historical program, including the founder, in 24 DGM-derived histories. Each receives six repair generations with two proposals. Keep executes the failed incumbent if no candidate passes. Stop or validated restoration chooses a currently passing historical program when one exists and otherwise pauses. Twenty-three histories recover after one generation and the last after two. Both policies therefore reach 24 correct endpoints, but keep executes one unsafe selected generation and stop pauses that generation. Pausing prevents unauthorized execution during repair but does not count as correct task completion.
paragraphs.zh: 独立的收据要求使所有历史程序（包括创始程序）在 24 个 DGM 派生历史中均无效。 每个程序都获得六个修复代，并附带两个提案。 如果没有候选程序通过，则继续执行失败的当前程序。 停止或验证恢复机制会在存在有效历史程序时选择当前通过的程序，否则暂停。 二十三个历史程序在一代后恢复，最后一个则在二代后恢复。 因此，两种策略都达到了 24 个正确的终点，但“继续”执行了一个不安全的选择代，而“停止”则暂停了该代。 暂停可以防止修复期间未经授权的执行，但不被视为任务的正确完成。

paragraphs.en: We measure service savings on a fixed routine workload and report separately the programs that remain correct. Among the 43 refresh endpoints correct on independent streams, the median reduction is 16.9% relative to one authoritative check per request. Across all 48 endpoints, the corresponding median is 16.6%, or 47.9% against the redundant founder. All 24 current-readout Casbin endpoints are correct and save a median 25.8% against their single-check reference. The single-check reference measures savings beyond a basic permission check, while the redundant founder includes extra checking work. Reporting correct endpoints separately also distinguishes completing the task efficiently from omitting permitted actions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在固定的常规工作负载上衡量服务节省量，并单独报告那些仍然正确的程序。 在 43 个独立流中保持正确的刷新端点中，相对于每次请求进行一次权威检查，其减少量的中位数为 16.9%。 在所有 48 个端点中，对应的中位数是 16.6%，或者相对于冗余创始人端点是 47.9%。 所有 24 个当前读取的 Casbin 端点都是正确的，并且相对于单次检查的参考方案，其节省量的中位数为 25.8%。 单次检查参考方案衡量的是超出基本权限检查之外的节省量，而冗余创始人则包含了额外的检查工作。 单独报告正确的端点也有助于区分高效完成任务与遗漏允许操作的情况。

paragraphs.en: In consent, inherited efficiency reaches 70.6% savings at generation 3, when safety is 15.3%. After full validation begins, savings decrease to 62.2% while safety rises to 33.3% at generation 12. Founder editing ends with 34.0% savings and 90.3% safety. Validated rollback instead increases consent savings from 9.9% after the first edit to 28.1% at the endpoint, while every selected generation remains fully correct. paragraphs.en: For authorization, seven frozen conversations receive withdrawal followed by zero, four, or 12 neutral dialogue pairs. Each delay/checkpoint cell pools 224 next-action queries across four methods, with no writes executed. Unauthorized-write proposals change from zero, 42, and 21 initially to zero, 40, and 17 at generation 6. Inherited efficiency alone changes from 16 of 168 to 14 of 168. paragraphs.en: Harness engineering and disclosure studies identify the surrounding execution harness as a central variable in agent reliability and evaluation [ Li et al., 2026 , Zhang et al., 2026c ] . Agent optimization also changes workflow structure and prompts. ADAS searches for agent designs expressed in code, and AFlow searches over workflows [ Hu et al., 2025 , Zhang et al., 2025b ] . GPTSwarm optimizes computational graphs of agents [ Zhuge et al., 2024 ] . Promptbreeder evolves task prompts and their mutation prompts, DSPy compiles and optimizes declarative language-model pipelines, and TextGrad propagates textual feedback through compound systems [ Fernando et al., 2024 , Khattab et al., 2024 , Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ] . EvoAgentX integrates workflow generation and optimization [ Wang et al., 2025a ] . These systems optimize agent designs, workflows, and prompts for later use. Our experiments ask whether an earlier evaluation remains sufficient when the authorization conditions for that use change.

paragraphs.en: Reflexion stores linguistic feedback to improve later decisions, while Self-Refine iteratively revises an output using feedback from the same model [ Shinn et al., 2023 , Madaan et al., 2023 ] . ExpeL extracts reusable insights from experience, and Memento adapts through memory-based learning without fine-tuning the underlying LLM [ Zhao et al., 2024 , Zhou et al., 2025 ] . These approaches show that adaptation need not change model weights [ Niu et al., 2026 ] . Continual visual adaptation similarly retains reusable prompts across changing domains [ Zhang et al., 2025c ] . These methods make the content supplied to future decisions consequential. Our shared-root experiment controls the starting failure and changes the code supplied to the next edit, providing a direct comparison of recovery under alternative editing contexts.
paragraphs.zh: Reflexion 会存储语言反馈以改进后续决策，而 Self-Refine 则利用同一模型提供的反馈对输出进行迭代修订 [ Shinn et al., 2023 , Madaan et al., 2023 ] 。 ExpeL 能从经验中提取可复用的洞察，而 Memento 则通过基于记忆的学习实现自适应，无需对底层的 LLM 进行微调 [ Zhao et al., 2024 , Zhou et al., 2025 ] 。 这些方法表明，自适应并不一定需要改变模型权重 [ Niu et al., 2026 ] 。 持续的视觉自适应同样能在不同变化领域中保留可复用的提示 [ Zhang et al., 2025c ] 。 这些方法使得提供给未来决策的内容具有决定性意义。 我们的共享根实验控制了初始失败，并改变了提供给下一次编辑的代码，从而直接比较了在不同编辑上下文中的恢复能力。

paragraphs.en: Voyager accumulates executable skills, SkillWeaver discovers and practices reusable web APIs, and Alita constructs and reuses external capabilities [ Wang et al., 2023 , Zheng et al., 2025 , Qiu et al., 2025 ] . Reuse is central to their capability gains. The permission-cache examples in this paper examine a safety condition on reuse: the dependencies supporting a past decision must still hold when that decision is applied. Our tasks test this dependency through recorded permission checks and actions. Surveys organize self-evolving agents across model, memory, tool, and architectural changes [ Gao et al., 2025 , Fang et al., 2025 ] , within which our setting focuses on executable agent components and their selection history.

paragraphs.en: Open-ended search raises tensions between continued innovation and control [ Ecoffet et al., 2020 ] , and safety analyses of open-ended systems emphasize evolving behavior and initial assumptions [ Sheth et al., 2025 ] . Misevolution supplies empirical evidence of risks across model, memory, tool, and workflow evolution, including unsafe tool creation and reuse [ Shao et al., 2026 ] . ATP studies drift through self-interested exploration and diffusion of strategies across agents [ Han et al., 2026 ] . Lifecycle analysis identifies how adversarial influences can persist and amplify through evolving systems [ Lin et al., 2026 ] . These are closely related findings. Our additional evidence comes from matched interventions: the same archive under different eligibility rules, the same rejected candidates under different fallbacks, and the same failed roots under different editing sources.

paragraphs.en: Parameter adaptation offers a complementary route to improvement. Absolute Zero and R-Zero develop self-generated training tasks, and RAGEN studies trajectory-level reinforcement learning for interactive agents [ Zhao et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2025 , Wang et al., 2025b ] . Broad model reports such as Qwen3 document capability and efficiency development at the model level [ Yang et al., 2025 ] . Safety can change under fine-tuning even without malicious user intent, and narrow insecure-code training can induce broader misalignment [ Qi et al., 2024b , Betley et al., 2025 ] . Sleeper Agents studies persistence of trained deceptive behavior, shallow-alignment analysis examines vulnerable response prefixes, and Safe LoRA seeks to preserve safety during efficient adaptation [ Hubinger et al., 2024 , Qi et al., 2024a , Hsu et al., 2024 ] . Our fixed-model design isolates retention and editing context from these changes to learned parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 参数自适应为改进模型提供了另一种补充路径。 Absolute Zero 和 R-Zero 会生成自训练任务，而 RAGEN 则研究交互式智能体的轨迹级强化学习 [ Zhao et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2025 , Wang et al., 2025b ] 。 Qwen3 等通用模型报告记录了模型层面上的能力与效率发展 [ Yang et al., 2025 ] 。 即使没有恶意用户意图，微调也可能改变模型的安全性；此外，针对不安全代码的窄域训练可能引发更广泛的对齐问题 [ Qi et al., 2024b , Betley et al., 2025 ] 。 Sleeper Agents 研究训练后欺骗行为的持续性，浅层对齐分析则考察易受攻击的响应前缀，而 Safe LoRA 旨在高效自适应过程中保持安全性 [ Hubinger et al., 2024 , Qi et al., 2024a , Hsu et al., 2024 ] 。 我们的固定模型设计将保留与编辑上下文与这些已学习参数的变化隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: Functional code benchmarks such as HumanEval and SWE-bench assess generated programs and repository changes [ Chen et al., 2021 , Jimenez et al., 2024 ] . RedCode evaluates risky execution and generation, whereas CWEval jointly tests functionality and security with outcome-based oracles [ Guo et al., 2024 , Peng et al., 2025 ] . Our full-correctness metric similarly requires both legitimate completion and authorized effects. Following selected programs across generations then distinguishes never entering failure, retaining a failure, repairing it, and producing a new failure after recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 像 HumanEval 和 SWE-bench 这样的功能代码基准测试，用于评估生成的程序以及代码库的变更 [ Chen et al., 2021 , Jimenez et al., 2024 ] 。 RedCode 评估高风险的执行与生成过程，而 CWEval 则通过基于结果的预言机，同时测试功能性与安全性 [ Guo et al., 2024 , Peng et al., 2025 ] 。 我们的完全正确性指标同样要求程序既需合法完成，也需产生授权的效果。 随后，通过追踪各代生成的特定程序，可以区分出从未进入失败状态、保留原有故障、修复故障以及在恢复后产生新故障等不同情况。

paragraphs.en: ToolEmu evaluates risks through emulated tool execution, and Agent-SafetyBench covers diverse interactions [ Ruan et al., 2024 , Zhang et al., 2024 ] . AgentDojo [ Debenedetti et al., 2024 ] and InjecAgent [ Zhan et al., 2024 ] evaluate indirect prompt injections. SafeArena studies harmful web-agent tasks, MobileSafetyBench studies device control, and AgentDAM evaluates unnecessary use of sensitive information [ Tur et al., 2025 , Lee et al., 2024 , Zharmagambetov et al., 2025 ] . Complementary studies examine agentic multimodal red teaming [ Zhang et al., 2026a ] and safety in agent social platforms [ Zhang et al., 2026b ] . These benchmarks cover risks and environments beyond our controlled contracts. Our native transfer study uses the released τ \tau and τ 2 \tau^{2} workflows, which evaluate interactive task completion under domain policies [ Yao et al., 2024 , Barres et al., 2025 ] . Its mixed outcomes support keeping task success and authorization behavior separate rather than treating one as a substitute for the other.
paragraphs.zh: ToolEmu 通过模拟工具执行来评估风险，而 Agent-SafetyBench 则涵盖了多样化的交互 [ Ruan et al., 2024 , Zhang et al., 2024 ] 。 AgentDojo [ Debenedetti et al., 2024 ] 和 InjecAgent [ Zhan et al., 2024 ] 用于评估间接提示注入问题。 SafeArena 研究有害的网络智能体任务，MobileSafetyBench 研究设备控制问题，而 AgentDAM 则评估敏感信息的非必要使用 [ Tur et al., 2025 , Lee et al., 2024 , Zharmagambetov et al., 2025 ] 。 补充性研究探讨了智能体多模态红队测试 [ Zhang et al., 2026a ] 以及智能体社交平台中的安全性问题 [ Zhang et al., 2026b ] 。 这些基准测试涵盖了超出我们受控合同范围的风险和环境。 我们的原生迁移研究使用了已发布的 τ \tau 和 τ 2 \tau^{2} 工作流程，这些流程用于评估在领域策略下的交互式任务完成能力 [ Yao et al., 2024 , Barres et al., 2025 ] 。 其混合结果支持将任务成功与授权行为分开处理，而非将二者视为替代关系。

paragraphs.en: Progent expresses programmable privilege controls, GuardAgent checks actions against safety requests through generated guardrail code, and TrustAgent uses an agent constitution to guide safer behavior [ Shi et al., 2025 , Xiang et al., 2025 , Hua et al., 2024 ] . Such controls can complement validation and restoration. Our execution-guard condition blocks unauthorized effects but does not repair evolved code that omits permitted work. Regression-testing research likewise studies behavioral preservation under program evolution and reduced test suites [ Shi et al., 2018 ] . The additional issue here is that retained code both executes and shapes the next model-generated revision, so recovery depends on editing source as well as detection coverage.
paragraphs.zh: Progent 实现了可编程的权限控制，GuardAgent 通过生成的护栏代码检查操作是否符合安全要求，而 TrustAgent 则借助智能体宪章来引导更安全的行为 [ Shi et al., 2025 , Xiang et al., 2025 , Hua et al., 2024 ] . 此类控制措施可以补充验证和恢复过程。 我们的执行-守护条件能够阻止未经授权的效应，但无法修复因省略允许操作而演变的代码。 回归测试研究同样探讨了程序演变和测试套件缩减条件下行为保持的问题 [ Shi et al., 2018 ] . 此处的另一个问题是，保留下来的代码既会执行，又会塑造模型生成的下一个修订版本，因此恢复不仅依赖于检测覆盖范围，还需要编辑源代码。

paragraphs.en: Editors differ in failure incidence and repair. Qwen accounts for most of the recovery difference between editing sources in the shared-root study. In the runs that start from correct programs, founder editing ends with fewer unsafe consent programs for all original editors. The identical-candidate study also shows that keep retains rejected programs with both GPT and Sonnet. The framework experiments run OpenEvolve components, upstream DGM functions, and Casbin on authorization workloads we constructed. Native τ \tau workflow transfer is mixed and does not establish a systematic increase in authorization failures (Appendix G ). The main controls assume a correct founder, an externally specified contract, and a correct validator. We do not vary the validator’s implementation. The all-history-invalid control tests restoration without a valid founder, and independent compositions expose coverage gaps. Service costs measure weighted operations rather than model inference or latency. Our fixed-editor experiments isolate persistent agent components and selection decisions within RSI, leaving joint evolution of the editor and its improvement strategy to further study.
paragraphs.zh: 不同编辑器的故障发生率和修复方式存在差异。 在共享根研究中，Qwen 解释了各编辑源之间恢复能力差异的大部分原因。 在从正确程序开始的运行中，初始编辑最终产生的不安全同意程序在所有原始编辑器中均更少。 相同候选研究也表明，在 GPT 和 Sonnet 两种情况下，“保留”操作都会维持被拒绝的程序。 该框架实验在为我们构建的授权工作负载上运行了 OpenEvolve 组件、上游 DGM 函数以及 Casbin。 原生 τ \tau 工作流程的迁移效果混杂，并未系统性地增加授权失败（附录 G）。 主要控制假设存在一个正确的初始程序、一个外部指定的合同以及一个正确的验证器。 我们没有改变验证器的实现方式。 “全部历史无效”控制测试了在无有效初始程序情况下的恢复过程，而独立组合则暴露了覆盖范围的空缺。 服务成本衡量的是加权操作，而非模型推理或延迟。 我们的固定编辑器实验隔离了 RSI 中持久的智能体组件和选择决策，将编辑器与其改进策略的联合演化留待进一步研究。
